title: KARMÅ drops a danceable new single with "right back"
htmlContent:
KARMÅ is excited to launch their most danceable track yet, "right back" featuring Kingdom Six, a song that will light up dance floors and playlists everywhere. You can feel the energy rising, driven by a catchy bassline and an engaging sound that makes you want to move. Created in KARMÅ's cozy home studio, known as the synth cube, "right back" beautifully combines old school sounds with modern vibes.

This track catches your ear and makes you want to dance. With each buildup and thrilling drop, KARMÅ captures the electrifying energy of a night out, leaving you buzzing long after the music stops. What makes "right back" special is its mix of familiar sounds and fresh ideas. The classic synths bring a warmth reminiscent of earlier dance music, while the modern production gives it a contemporary feel. Every sound has been carefully crafted to draw listeners into its infectious groove, making it hard to resist pressing replay.

https://open.spotify.com/track/3505cVoYBrOH20FEFAHj3b?si=nH1XWBP9Q7mL-dNgyP_WWg

As KARMÅ puts it, "right back" captures that feeling of sheer joy on the dance floor and that exhilarating rush that keeps you coming back for more. Whether you're at a festival, in a club, or just enjoying music with your headphones on, this track can transport you to a place where music and movement come together perfectly. With this new release, KARMÅ elevates their music and establishes themselves as a significant player in the electronic music world. "right back" is something you feel, and once it hooks you, you won't want to let go.
